description: Strong premium travel rendering with tonal depth, rich believable color, atmospheric separation, and crisp natural detail.
editing_goals: Create a strong premium travel-photography appearance with rich believable color and crisp natural detail
Build deep tonal and atmospheric separation across foreground, midground, and background
Enhance attractive skies, water, natural greens, and warm light when present
cautions: Preserve realistic skin and sky color
Keep clarity and dehaze restrained enough to remain believable
Avoid timid contrast or an unfinished merely corrected result

guidance: Correct obvious accidental horizon and waterline tilt
Preserve natural framing and environmental context
Do not confuse sloping terrain or irregular structures with camera roll
